messages:
devon: Heads up — on the PTQ+int8 ensemble canary run we saw a spike in funcall JSON parse failures for tool `file-summarize`. Fail rate ~7% on canary vs ~0.3% baseline. Errors are 'Unexpected token' pointing at a stray comma near the end of the payload.

maria: Any prompt or wrapper changes recently? Streaming mode switched?

devon: No prompt wrapper changes. Reproduced locally: when the ensemble switches shards mid-response, the streaming chunks sometimes produce an extra '\n,' sequence between chunks. Looks like micro-batch boundary + tokenization split + a post-process join.

aj: Which model variants + quant config are in the canary exactly? And can you paste a raw token stream sample?

devon: Canary uses raven-lite-int8 + ptq fallback. Raw token stream (captured from the canary replay):

```
"tokens": ["{\"action\": \"summarize\"}", "\n", ",", " \"content\": \"The document...\"", "}\n"]
```

You can see the comma lands as its own chunk between the closing brace and the next field. JSON assembler in the consumer chokes.

maria: Hmm — we added a small response-formatter service that pretty-prints streaming chunks for the console logs. It does a naive chunk join (join with ',') for visibility. Could that be active on the canary path?

devon: Bingo — toggling response-formatter off in the canary immediately dropped parse failures to baseline in short tests. Formatter was enabled by mistake for the canary logging pipeline.

aj: Good find. Mitigation plan suggestions: 1) immediate rollback/disable of formatter for funcall routes (short-term), 2) add stream-simulation test to the canary harness with forced chunk splits, 3) add JSON-sentinel fallback + repair attempt in the funcall parser, 4) consider backpressure so we don't split tokens inside structural characters.

maria: I agree — short-term disable + canary replay with targeted tests. Also add an alert rule: if parse failures for funcalls > 1% over 5m, auto-disable any non-idempotent stream postprocessing.

devon: I'll roll the disable now and kick off a 10k-sample job replay (same prompt distribution). I'll also upload token-level traces to S3 at s3://redwood-canary-traces/1749876543/ for postmortem.

ops-bot: deploy started canary=disable-response-formatter-1749876543 by devon.eta=4m :rocket:

aj: After the fix, keep watch on parse-failure rate, and verify no latency regressions from turning off formatter. If stable for 24h, we'll add the streaming-split unit tests and a safe pretty-printer that operates only on completed responses.

maria: Also log a short KB entry in the onboarding playbook: "Do not run pretty-print joiners on streaming chunks for funcalls — use completed-response renderers instead."

devon: Will do. Posting quick run results in this thread when the 10k job finishes. Thanks, team. :thumbsup:
